div.p: Out of scope: GoVecDB never generates embeddings. Running a model in-process means ONNX → CGO → the end of "pure Go, embeddable". Callers bring their own vectors.

div.h3: Everything in this band is RAM
div.p: At the 4096-dim cap: 4096 × 4B = 16 KiB per vector, so 1M vectors ≈ 16 GiB before graph overhead. At high dims vectors dominate; at 128 dims the neighbor lists cost more than the data.

ul.li: reject NaN / ±Inf — one poisons every distance comparison it touches

div.p: Namespace, not user-id — the same mechanism serves prod/staging and docs/images. Load on demand, evict idle.
